newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela may reduce income tax, broaden tax base.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela may reduce income tax, broaden tax base.

text.p: Venezuelan Tax Superintendency Seniat is to ask congress to drop the maximum income tax rate to 30 percent from 34 percent and reduce the minimum level of taxable income to 225,000 bolivars ($485) per month, Seniat said.
With tax avoidance currently running at 74 percent, Seniat said the proposed measures were designed to broaden the country's tax base and encourage the return of workers to the formal sector.

Nearly 50 percent of the Venezuelan workforce is estimated to work in the informal sector. Income tax revenues currently account for less than 0.2 percent of Gross Domestic Product, Seniat added in the press release.
